blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House lawmakers on Wednesday filed a resolution urging President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to declare Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan persona non grata or ask Beijing to recall him, following similar Senate measures prompted by the envoy’s remark that China could easily win a conflict. Ten lawmakers, including Senior Deputy Minority Leader and Mamamayang Liberal Rep. Leila de Lima and Akbayan Reps. Chel Diokno, Percival Cendana and Dadah Ismula, filed House Resolution No. 1562.
